Menu.Name: Creature art
Menu.Label: Manage creature art
Menu.Hint: Apply the bundled Demiplane art to world creatures that still use a default image, or revert it. Creatures added from PF2e compendia get the art automatically.

Manager.Title: Creature art
Manager.Intro: World NPCs only. Portraits and tokens are replaced only while they still show a default image. Creatures with a token on any scene are left alone.
Manager.ConfirmApply: Apply creature art to {count} world NPCs? You can revert this later.
Manager.ConfirmRevert: Restore the original images on {count} world NPCs? Images you changed yourself since applying are kept.
